description: Whole-filesystem name search and content search in one stack (built from source, SIMD detected)

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src)) { throw ('the source tree is missing: ' + $src) }

if (-not (Get-Command cargo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'cargo is not on the PATH. This package builds the tree from source: install Rust with rustup (https://rustup.rs) and the Microsoft C++ build tools, then install this package again.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'rustc could not read the CPU it is running on.' }
if ($target) { Write-Host ('the CPU carries ' + $target) } else { Write-Host 'the CPU carries the portable build' }
try { & cargo build --release --locked --workspace --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('the build failed with exit ' + $LASTEXITCODE) } } finally { Pop-Location }

foreach ($name in @('searchctl.exe', 'searchd.exe', 'rgy-autostart.exe', 'rgxy.exe')) { $from = Join-Path $bin $name; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $from)) { throw ('the build did not produce ' + $name) }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $from -Destination (Join-Path $here $name) -Force }
Write-Host 'the source tree and the build directory are gone: what is left is the five binaries'

post_install: info 'rgy (built from source) READ THIS. Despite the name, searchctl is NOT a systemd service and does not require systemd.'
info '  It is a plain CLI. The daemon (searchd) is a separate, OPTIONAL binary.'
info '  Nothing installed here depends on the system init.'
info '  This is the source build: the tree was compiled on THIS machine, with the SIMD it carries.'
info '  rgxy (the launcher) answers without the daemon too: it falls back to its own name index of your home folder.'
info '  How do you want the search daemon enabled?'
info '    [1] Register it for the NEXT LOGON only (the install does not start it now).'
info '    [2] Register it AND start it NOW in this session. (default)'
info '    [Y] Accept the default - same as [2].'
info '  Note: registering alone never starts the daemon in the current session - HKCU Run'
info '  entries run at logon. And on its first start the daemon rebuilds the index of your'
info '  home directory before it opens its pipe, which can take a minute on a large tree;'
info '  rgxy will keep saying ''no connection to the daemon'' until that rebuild finishes.'
info '  Press 1, 2, N or Y to decide - no answer within 10 seconds keeps the default [2].'
info '  (no interactive console: keeping the default [2].)'
info '  (non-interactive install: no prompt. Using the default: register AND start the daemon now.)'
info '  Registering the daemon (no elevation, no dialog) ...'
info '  Registered through ''current'', so the next version bump keeps the daemon working.'
info '  Starting the daemon now (detached; it keeps running after this install) ...'
info '  It is indexing your home directory first; rgxy connects when the pipe opens.'
info '  Check progress with: rgy-autostart-git doctor --name rgy-searchd-git'
info '  Registered. It will start at your NEXT LOGON, not now.'
info '  To start it sooner: rgy-autostart-git doctor --name rgy-searchd-git'
info '  Undo it later with: rgy-autostart-git uninstall --name rgy-searchd-git'
info '  No daemon installed. Two things to know:'
info '   - searchctl needs an INDEX, not a daemon. Index at least once:'

info '   - Try the launcher with nothing installed: Start-Process searchd.exe -ArgumentList ''--root'',$env:USERPROFILE,''--listen'',''pipe:rgy-try''; rgxy.exe --endpoint pipe:rgy-try --query invoice'
info '     Or just use searchctl-git for one question. See the README for a daily index timer.'
